marginalia.note: Idest, quatenus homo. Sedphrasis incommoda est & periculosa.

page.notes: Printed marks: the asterisk after "Christus" and the asterisk after "Rom.14.9" are reference marks; the second has no printed note. The note text "Sedphrasis incommoda est & periculosa." is read from a small italic margin block and is partly doubtful; the word break "in-commoda" is set as printed in the margin. "conjun-&ta" reads as printed; the word is likely "conjuncta" with the "&" part of the line break. "fervilisquidâ" and "reveretia" are copied as printed. The first word "lus." is a fragment from the previous page.
